why: The first live failure was an ordering defect: Claude writes a positional prompt before SessionStart,
then the generic adopt-at-end contract skips the only run opener. The repair cannot change the

A live PR #933 probe then proved the opposite edge: retaining an early SessionStart can make it
arrive before Claude creates the transcript path at all. One ENOENT terminally stopped the emitter
while the model and DMs worked. Startup now retries only that missing-file state for five seconds;
retained and recovered sources keep their strict existing-file behavior.

mutations.name: S1 treat startup like a generic adopt, recreating the live skipped-run-opener defect
mutations.find:
case "startup":
      return new StartupClaudeTranscriptSource(file, opts.startupFileWaitMs ?? STARTUP_TRANSCRIPT_WAIT_MS);

mutations.name: S2 replay retained history by treating resume/fork/clear/compact as startup
mutations.find:
case "resume":
    case "fork":
    case "clear":
    case "compact":
      return file;
mutations.replace:
case "resume":
    case "fork":
    case "clear":
    case "compact":
      return new StartupClaudeTranscriptSource(file, opts.startupFileWaitMs ?? STARTUP_TRANSCRIPT_WAIT_MS);
